## Install from the zip

1. Download `personal-chat-superpower-<version>.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and select the unzipped folder.
3. Open chatgpt.com or claude.ai and click the extension icon to open the side panel.

To update: unzip the new version over the old folder (or into a new one and load that), then press the reload button on `chrome://extensions`. Your data lives in the browser and is kept.

Optional local LLM and Obsidian setup: see the [README](https://github.com/iks9245/personal-chat-superpower#readme).

> Unofficial project, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic. It reads undocumented web APIs that can change at any time; programmatic access may conflict with those services' terms of use.

Something broken after a site update? Run **Settings → Diagnostics**, copy the report, and [open an issue](https://github.com/iks9245/personal-chat-superpower/issues/new/choose).
